fixup_dispatch: simt_row4, then utcmma64, then utcmma128 by num_parallel_states and SM count

launch_policy.checkpoint_copy_order: state fixup, then sequence-major fixed-state boundary copy, then optional final-state scatter, then CP prefill
launch_policy.default_cp_chunk_len: checkpoint interval when enabled; otherwise pinned PR4078 choose_cp_chunk_len_host arithmetic

dtype_dispatch.state_io: typed gather/scatter selected independently from state dtype; FP32 checkpoint copy reuses state_gather_fp32

launch_policy.replay: tight-bound CUDA Graph for non-in-place state and direct captured native composite for in-place state; four ordered semantic stages and four to seven Cake kernels according to state IO form
launch_policy.stage4_equal_head_dispatch: aligned float16 equal-head H32 inputs use cp_prefill_equal_head_h32; other aligned float16 equal-head inputs use cp_prefill_equal_head; generic-tail, BF16, GQA, and GVA inputs retain their existing kernels
launch_policy.stage4_tail_dispatch: exact-full-block kernel iff every sequence length is divisible by 128; otherwise generic-tail kernel
launch_policy.tensor_map_abi: grid_constant for every TMA-backed stage; no process-lifetime descriptor arena

source_normalization: prepend the FlashInfer Apache-2.0 header; bracket generated C++/CUDA with clang-format markers; strip trailing blank lines and retain one final newline

checkpoint.interval: zero disables checkpoints; otherwise a positive multiple of 64 that becomes the CP chunk length

head_mapping.gqa: Hk == Hv and Hq is an integer multiple of Hk
head_mapping.gva: Hq == Hk and Hv is an integer multiple of Hq

support_contract.route: all legal pinned PR4078 SM100/SM103 CP inputs plus the declared FP32 boundary-checkpoint extension
support_contract.sequence_lengths: any nonempty tuple of positive lengths within CUDA allocation and grid limits
support_contract.state_layout: packed or unique-int32 indexed pool; contiguous inner [H,V,K], arbitrary padded row stride, optional in-place output identity
